name: Debranch expedition completion
goal: Prove that concluding an expedition never requires its canonical branch to exist: CompleteExpedition leaves the branch-gated set (only StartExpedition remains gated, since its branch exists by construction at start time) because a completion-time branch may already be merged and deleted, may never have existed, or may be unavailable on another checkout. Align the CLI guard, ExecutionGate phase, and checkpoint step; update tests/execution-branch-gate.test.js
